    "Cache",
    "FIFOCache",
    "LFUCache",
    "LRUCache",
    "MRUCache",
    "RRCache",
    "TLRUCache",
    "TTLCache",
    "cached",
    "cachedmethod",
)'''

new_all = '''__all__ = (
    "Cache",
    "FIFOCache",
    "LFUCache",
    "LRUCache",
    "RRCache",
    "TLRUCache",
    "TTLCache",
    "cached",
    "cachedmethod",
)'''

content = content.replace(old_all, new_all)

with open("src/cachetools/__init__.py", "w") as f:
    f.write(content)

print("Updated __init__.py to remove MRUCache from __all__")
